submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2 mm gas gap is recommended because it achieves the best time resolution (1.267 ns) among all environmentally compliant options. Mixture-G2, despite showing excellent time resolution (0.9 ns at 2mm in previous simulations), exceeds the mandatory GWP100 limit of 150 and must be excluded. Mixture-G3 is compliant but delivers significantly worse time resolution (1.976 ns at 2mm). The 2mm gap provides optimal performance for Mixture-G1, outperforming both the 1mm (1.465 ns) and 3mm (1.462 ns) configurations.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Based on recorded results: best_time_resolution_ns = 1.267 for Mixture-G1 at 2mm gap

requirements.requirement: Mixture must be one of the three candidates
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 is one of the candidates from candidate_specs.md
